title: Add LLM operation audit hooks

context.summary: Add structured audit logging for LLM disabled attempts and executed model calls.
context.background: TASK-53 introduced audit result shapes and TASK-54 moved consumers through @mindory/llm. The runtime still needs an audit hook that records role, provider, model, duration, usage, status and operation refs when model operations are skipped or executed.

in: Emit audit records for disabled role attempts.
Wrap current text embedding provider calls to emit success/failure audit records.
Include role, provider, model, duration, usage, status and optional project/document/job/session refs in the audit shape.
Update validators and docs for LLM audit behavior.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/llm exposes an audit sink option for operation audit records.
Disabled role attempts emit audit records with status disabled.
Text embedding calls emit success and failure audit records with duration and usage where available.
Consumers can pass operation refs without importing provider packages directly.
Docs describe current in-process audit sink behavior and that persistence is future work.
No database schema changes are included.
risks: Audit wrapper must preserve the existing EmbeddingsProvider interface.
Failures must be audited and rethrown so existing retry semantics are unchanged.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
